pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] cont-batching-prod: p99 latency > 2s in region-usw2 — triggered at 3322109876. paging oncall: @alex, @maria

alex: seeing the pager. digging in — initial dashboard shows p95 from 220ms -> 1.4s, p99 ~2.2s, spike started ~10:50 UTC. any recent deploys? :eyes:

maria: no prod deploys. telemetry shows a tail spike on the continuous-batching path, streaming RPCs experiencing stalls. I see a surge of mixed-seq requests from model: gpt-open-7B-quant.

samir: adding logs from the batcher (sampling):
```
[10:50:12] batcher: queue_len=87 active_batches=13 avg_batch=8 last_batch=32 
[10:50:13] kv_cache: evict_rate=0.0 miss_rate=0.42
[10:50:13] streaming-worker-17: stall_detected, wait_ms=1200
```

alex: that last_batch=32 stands out — we usually cap streaming batch size at 8 for low latency. why are 32-size batches forming?

emily: routing policy recently allowed packing for throughput during offpeak, but region-usw2 should be in low-latency config. checking routing rules...

ops-bot: config-change: routing-policy/usw2 updated by @jay at 3322109500 — set allow_pack_for_streaming=true for model-family:gpt-open

jay: that was a temporary tweak to improve throughput overnight; I forgot to revert when traffic patterns changed. :grimacing:

maria: ok root cause candidate: packing config allowed large batches that are breaking streaming fast-path and causing stalls at the runtime layer. mixed sequence lengths amplify latency due to padding -> compute jitter.

samir: additional evidence: seqlen histogram for the last 15m: short (<=32): 73%, long (>512): 4%, medium (33-512): 23%. Pack algorithm combined short+long in same batches. Long sequences push GPU kernels into paging mode and stall streamers.

alex: mitigation plan — immediate: revert routing-policy to disallow packing for streaming in region-usw2, and enable small-batch-shed to keep batch_size<=8 for streaming routes. Can someone roll a quick config?

jay: rolling revert now. patch: `allow_pack_for_streaming=false` on routing-policy/usw2. Will push and monitor.

ops-bot: deploy started by @jay 3322109950 — rolling config change to routing-policy/usw2

maria: while jay pushes, we should also activate emergency preempt on queued batches > 12 to avoid tail amplification. alex — can you flip preempt-policy?

alex: flipping preempt-policy -> `preempt_threshold=12` on cont-batcher pool-usw2 now.

samir: enabling KV-cache read-only sticky for streaming workers to avoid thrashing; setting kv_prefetch=false for streaming routes.

customer-success: any customer-facing impact? Are we hitting any active SLOs for paid tenants?

emily: per billing logs, 3 enterprise tenants saw increased 95/99 latency but no errors. SLA alerting hasn't fired yet, but degraded experience expected for some interactive customers. Recommend proactive email if latency doesn't recover in 30 min.

ops-bot: deploy completed 3322109975 — routing-policy/usw2 reverted.

samir: metrics update after revert + preempt + kv tweaks: p95 down from 1.4s -> 310ms, p99 down from 2.2s -> 560ms within 2m. streaming stall events count dropped 78%. Looks promising.

alex: good. next steps: 1) keep mitigation for 30m and watch, 2) roll a canary for a smarter packer that respects seqlen buckets (short-only packing), 3) postmortem + customer impact assessment. Assign owners?

maria: I'll own the canary for the packer change and the postmortem doc. ETA for canary: 6 hours.

samir: I'll run a simulation load to reproduce mixed-seq pack amplification and add a unit test for packing fairness. Report back in 2 hours.

jay: I'll notify infra to add an automated guard: do not allow pack_for_streaming toggles without a temporary 30m auto-revert. Also add an alert when avg_batch_size > 10 on streaming routes.

customer-success: I'll draft a short note for affected customers if p95/p99 doesn't recover in 30m. Keeping them informed is priority.

alex: handoff: @maria will take lead for follow-up and postmortem. I'm leaving shift in 45m; @samir you take on-call after that. If anything regresses escalate to @jay and paging as usual.

emily: timeline log:
- 3322109876 pager fired (p99>2s)
- 3322109950 revert pushed by @jay
- 3322109975 revert completed
- 3322109990 p99 real-time fell below 800ms

maria: capturing action items for postmortem: [A1] packer smart-bucket canary (owner: maria), [A2] add auto-revert guard for packing toggles (owner: jay), [A3] alert for streaming avg_batch_size > 10 (owner: jay), [A4] packing fairness test & sim (owner: samir), [A5] customer comms draft (owner: customer-success).

samir: quick note — we should also evaluate lowering max_padding for streaming kernels; long sequences cause kernel fallback. Adding as A6 (owner: samir).

alex: Thanks team. I'll mark this as handoff and watchlist to ensure no regression. Please update thread with any follow-ups. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-bridge created #inc-3322109876-live-bridge by @alex
